def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Equação empírica para log10(|ID|/A) ao longo da curva de transferência."""
    """Power-law equation for log10(|ID|/A) along transfer curve."""
    alpha, beta, gamma = parameters[:3]  # alpha, beta, gamma are the power-law exponents
    A = parameters[3]  # the prefactor for the active area
    K = parameters[4]  # the shift value for the curve
    return A * (gate_voltage_abs ** (beta)) + K
